recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to white. 2. Add title 'Effect of Selecting Threshold Value on Model Performance' at top center in large bold dark red (#C00000) sans-serif. 3. Place a yellow (#FFFF00) circle at the top-right corner with black text '22'. 4. Top-left: draw a 2x2 table with header 'Predicted as' over columns P and N, and 'Actual' as the row header. Fill cells with TP, FN, FP, TN. Highlight the TP cell with green fill (#00B050). 5. To the right of this matrix, add a red-bordered box containing 'Threshold=0.3'. 6. Below the first matrix, draw a second 2x2 table with the same 'Predicted as' (P, N) header and 'Actual' row header with row labels P and N. Enter values: row P = 5, 0; row N = 2, 4. 7. Top-center/right: build a horizontal flowchart. Box 1 'Test Sample' with a small airplane image. Arrow to Box 2 'Model' with dark red fill (#C00000) and white text. Arrow to Box 3 with header 'Predicted Value', main text '(0 --- 1)', and subtext '[Any value] → (0, +1)'. Arrow to Box 4 'Threshold (e.g. 0.5)'. From Box 4, two arrows branch to 'Class I' (green fill #00B050) and 'Class II' (pink fill #FFC0CB). 8. Bottom: draw a horizontal number line from 0.0 to 1.0 with tick marks and labels at 0.0, 0.5, and 1.0. Add a vertical dashed line at 0.5. 9. Above the number line, place simple airplane line drawings: cluster most on the left of 0.5 with small red dots, place several on the right with blue dots, and add one on the far right with a skull-and-crossbones symbol. 10. Verify all text matches the verbatim transcription exactly.
